contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise users

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: Feature 1
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: Additional Feature:-
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

referenceMap.heroPattern: Single-screen split hero with strong brand/logo presence, large headline, supporting summary, and compact benefit bullets; visual weight is concentrated in typography rather than imagery.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Lead with a prominent hero band, then transition into a high-contrast lead capture/form block; subsequent product content should follow a stacked, single-column narrative with clear section separation.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Form-card / content-card treatment with solid surface, framed container, and minimal decoration; emphasis on clarity, hierarchy, and scannability over ornament.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA-first pattern with one dominant action in the hero and repeated conversion prompts in downstream sections; secondary actions should be omitted or de-emphasized when unnecessary.
referenceMap.pricingPattern: Not present in the reference; if added, use a separate modular block with clear plan segmentation and strong spacing rather than embedding within the hero.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the reference; assume a simple utility/footer strip with low visual emphasis.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage; brand/logo at the top and content-led sections without large illustrative panels. If media is introduced, keep it secondary to headline hierarchy.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Sequential product modules with label, headline, description, CTA, and a bullet-like feature list. Use repetitive structure for easy comparison between offerings, with each module acting as a self-contained feature block.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead form card directly beneath the hero with a short title and dense hidden metadata fields; conversion-oriented, compact, and visually isolated from marketing copy.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Static, presentation-first layout with no visible motion system; if motion is used, keep it subtle and limited to standard UI transitions.
componentPatterns: Bullet benefit list with check icons
Feature list items with short titles and descriptions
designNotes: Use a conversion-led landing page structure with immediate brand recognition and a direct CTA above the fold.
Keep typography large and authoritative; minimize decorative elements.
Prefer stacked content blocks and clear vertical separation over complex multi-column storytelling.
Support scanning with short benefit bullets and repeated feature patterns.
Make forms visually distinct and near the top of the page to reduce friction.
The reference favors utility and clarity over interaction-heavy UI.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, content teams, and enterprise buyers producing premium visual assets at scale
personality.emotion: Awe, control, speed, and creative confidence
personality.reasoning: This product sits between creative production and enterprise AI infrastructure, so the visual language should feel cinematic but disciplined. Seedream 4.5 is about image precision, typography, and composition; Seedance 1.5 Pro adds motion, audio, and narrative depth. The identity should therefore blend creative-studio energy with enterprise-grade clarity: bold orange brand equity from Techjockey, high-contrast editorial layouts, layered product storytelling, and interactive panels that make the AI capability feel intelligent, premium, and operationally trustworthy.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long, so it needs a tighter hero scale to preserve hierarchy and avoid wrapping issues while still feeling premium.

colours.colourReason: The palette is derived exclusively from Techjockey’s provided brand colors. Orange becomes the signature action color and hero background accent, while black, white, and soft grey create strong editorial contrast. Because the brand does not provide alternate product-specific colors, the system uses tonal layering, contrast, and surface variation rather than introducing unrelated hues.

layout.heroBackground: #ff6b00 with layered dark/white product visual panel on the right
layout.heroReason: The product benefits from a split hero because strong visual proof is important for generative AI. The orange hero creates immediate brand recognition, while the right-side layered panel can show abstract model shells, floating output cards, and before/after visual intelligence without requiring literal screenshots.
layout.featureReason: The product has two major pillars—image generation and video generation—so alternating sections creates stronger contrast and helps separate Seedream 4.5 from Seedance 1.5 Pro. Within each section, use split-panel storytelling and feature cards for clarity.
layout.darkSectionFor: The Seedance 1.5 Pro section and proof/metrics bands should use a dark sectional treatment to emphasize cinematic motion, audio-visual sync, and premium contrast against the earlier light sections.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a cinematic composite style: abstract AI output frames, floating prompt chips, model name badges, metric pills, and layered UI shells that suggest image and video generation pipelines. If product visuals are unavailable, create rich CSS-based mock panels with shadows, thin borders, grid overlays, and glowing orange edge highlights. Show Seedream as crisp, high-fidelity image tiles; show Seedance as motion strips, timeline blocks, waveform hints, and synchronized audio-visual frames.
personality.designPersonality: Premium creative intelligence with enterprise discipline: cinematic, sharp, and highly composed. The page should feel like an AI production suite for serious creators—visually rich, interactive, and polished, but not flashy or playful. Orange is the unmistakable brand anchor; black and white supply authority; layered panels, floating chips, and split storytelling deliver the sense of advanced generative capability.

designIntent.audience: Professionals creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise users
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance generative AI models for premium image and video creation, then request a demo or quote for enterprise use

brandDirection.tone: Expert, technically credible, and conversion-focused with a premium enterprise feel
brandDirection.visualStyle: Typography-led landing page with strong hierarchy, minimal decoration, compact content cards, and clear segmentation between image and video offerings

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish immediate value proposition for AI image and video generation, communicate premium quality, and push the primary conversion action above the fold
Explain the image generation capability clearly, with scannable feature proof and a direct request-demo action
Present the video generation capability as a distinct but related module, emphasizing audiovisual synchronization and production speed
Provide quote-oriented purchase framing for both products and support enterprise evaluation
Add credibility through role-based proof from creative professionals

componentNeeds.variantHint: single-screen typography-first hero with strong brand presence and compact supporting bullets
componentNeeds.notes: Use a high-contrast hero with white text on a dark or brand-led background. Keep the primary CTA visually dominant. Secondary CTA is not provided and should not be introduced. Since no form is included, the hero should carry the conversion pressure and set the technical/premium tone.

componentNeeds.variantHint: short bullet list beneath supporting line
componentNeeds.notes: Highlight the multimodal inputs and professional output quality as fast-scan proof points. Keep bullets tight and executive-friendly.

componentNeeds.variantHint: feature module with label, headline, description, CTA, and stacked bullet features
componentNeeds.notes: Use a self-contained card or framed block with clear hierarchy. Feature list should read as scannable proof, not marketing prose.
Prioritize text-image alignment, high resolution, typography rendering, multi-image composition, and structural fidelity. This section should feel precise and product-led.

componentNeeds.variantHint: feature module with equal visual weight to image product, but slightly more technical
componentNeeds.notes: Keep the video product visually parallel to the image module so the user can compare offerings. Do not overdo media or motion treatments.
Group capabilities around generation, synchronization, lip-sync, camera control, and inference speed. Use dense but readable spacing.

Present both products as separate plan cards. Keep the pricing section modular and clearly segmented. Seedance has a starting monthly price; Seedream is quote-based. CTA should remain request/quote-oriented.
Use only the three valid testimonials. Ignore the incomplete fourth quote. Emphasize job titles to strengthen relevance for creative decision-makers.

layoutStrategy.hero: Typography-first hero with strong brand color field, compact supporting line, and one dominant CTA. Prioritize fast comprehension over imagery. Keep the hero visually dense enough to feel enterprise-grade but uncluttered.
layoutStrategy.features: Use stacked, single-column product modules with clear internal hierarchy. Each module should have a label, headline, short description, and bullet-like feature list. Maintain repeated structure for comparability between Seedream and Seedance.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials as role-based validation from creative professionals. Keep trust cues subtle and content-led since no badges or customer count are available.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Use a separate modular pricing section with two clearly divided cards. Avoid embedding pricing into the hero. Make the quote flow obvious and enterprise-friendly.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be added because the input explicitly has includeForm false and no form content is provided.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Default enterprise-professional token profile: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body copy, with a dark authority-led hero treatment and restrained accent usage. Maintain crisp spacing, strong contrast, and minimal ornamentation.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a single-product B2B landing page for two related AI generation products, optimized for lead generation and quote/demo requests. Start with a bold, text-led hero that sells premium AI image and video creation. Follow with two parallel product modules for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, each using a card-based, highly scannable feature structure. Add a separate pricing block with quote-oriented plan cards, then close with testimonial proof from creative roles. Keep the system modular, enterprise-credible, and low on decorative motion.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Default Techjockey token set with marketing-friendly typography; use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body, with a bold accent-led CTA treatment.

sections.variantHint: single-screen centered hero without media; strong background color, prominent brand presence, compact benefit bullets, dual CTA area where secondary CTA is visually present but can be empty-state hidden if not supplied
sections.notes: Use a full-width hero band with strong brand color background and white text. Since no explicit secondary CTA text is provided, reserve the slot for structure but render only the primary CTA if needed. Include concise supporting line and a compact 3-bullet benefit summary derived from the supporting line and product category; keep typographic hierarchy dominant and avoid large imagery.

sections.frameName: Trust Strip / Lightweight Brand Proof Row
sections.variantHint: light grey separator band with centered stat/badge row; if no badges or proof content exists, use a restrained empty trust divider with the section title omitted
sections.notes: The input trust object has no badges, social proof, or customer count, so keep this section extremely minimal or skip visual emphasis. If included for structure, make it a thin utility strip separating hero from product content, not a promotional block. Do not fabricate stats or badges.

sections.variantHint: self-contained content card with label, headline, body copy, CTA, and 5-item feature list
sections.notes: Build as a single-column, content-led module with a strong section label and clear product name. Place the description first, then the CTA, then a scannable feature list using repeated row items or compact cards. Keep the structure repetitive and easy to compare against the next product module. Use white surface with subtle border and generous spacing.

sections.variantHint: self-contained content card with label, headline, body copy, CTA slot if present, and 6-item feature list
sections.notes: Mirror the Seedream module structure for consistency. The CTA field is empty in the source, so keep a CTA slot available only if the design system requires it, otherwise omit the button and maintain visual parity through spacing and typography. Use a clean stacked feature list with bullet-like rows for each capability.

sections.variantHint: two modular plan cards with clear segmentation; keep one plan visually emphasized through price treatment only, not decorative complexity
sections.notes: Use a separate pricing block after product details. Since pricing input is partial and one plan lacks explicit price, build both plan cards as structured quote/request blocks rather than a transactional checkout. Preserve the list of inclusions, include a strong CTA on each card, and do not invent missing pricing values. If any price is absent, leave it blank and style as 'Request quote' state.

sections.variantHint: 3-column card grid with consistent quote formatting; include only valid testimonials and omit placeholder entries
sections.notes: Render only the three complete testimonials. Exclude the incomplete fourth entry with quote 'T' because it is not usable content. Each card should include star rating, italic quote, bold author, and grey designation. Keep cards compact and consistent for scanability.

sections.variantHint: prominent isolated form card with compact metadata treatment; if fields are absent, reserve a structured form shell for future completion
sections.notes: The source form object contains no fields, headline, or CTA text, so create a form shell only if the layout requires a conversion anchor. Keep it visually isolated, card-based, and compact. Do not invent field labels or submit copy. If the designer prefers strict content fidelity, this section can be omitted from the final build because it lacks usable content.

sections.variantHint: minimal utility footer with low emphasis
sections.notes: Keep footer minimal because no footer content is supplied. Use only a narrow utility strip with restrained brand treatment and no additional marketing claims.

sections.variantHint: stacked hero with text-only emphasis; preserve CTA hierarchy and compact benefit bullets
sections.notes: Stack all hero content vertically. Keep headline size reduced to fit mobile but still prominent. The CTA should be full-width and primary-first. Since no media is supplied, keep this text-led and avoid adding imagery. Maintain strong background color and tight vertical rhythm.

sections.variantHint: minimal separator state with no fabricated proof elements
sections.notes: Because the trust object is empty, collapse this to a small separator if needed or omit completely. Do not create badges, counts, or logos.

sections.variantHint: single-column cards with feature items stacked one per row
sections.notes: Convert the desktop card into a full-width stacked mobile module. Keep the CTA as a full-width button if shown. Feature rows should remain scannable and not split into columns.

sections.variantHint: single-column cards with feature items stacked one per row
sections.notes: Keep the same stacked structure as Seedream for consistency and comparison. Omit CTA if no valid CTA text exists. Use ample padding between feature rows to preserve readability on small screens.

sections.variantHint: two plan cards stacked vertically with quote-style CTA treatment
sections.notes: Stack plan cards vertically. Preserve inclusion lists. Leave missing price fields blank without placeholder values. Ensure CTA buttons are full width and consistent. If pricing card density feels too high, maintain a clear typographic separation between plan title, price, includes, and CTA.

sections.variantHint: single-column testimonial cards; exclude incomplete testimonial content
sections.notes: Show only the three valid testimonials in a vertical stack. Keep each card compact, with the quote first, then author details. The invalid short quote entry must be removed.

sections.variantHint: full-width card shell for future form completion
sections.notes: Only include if the product team wants a placeholder conversion area. Since the form has no fields or CTA copy, keep it as a restrained shell and avoid creating content that isn't provided.
A simple footer strip closes the page. Keep it visually quiet and do not add new trust or navigation content.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use a single design system token set across desktop and mobile with a strong primary brand surface for the hero and white cards for all downstream content.
Keep content fidelity strict: do not invent missing trust proof, form fields, or pricing values; omit or shell empty states where necessary.
Repeat the product module structure for both offerings to create comparison parity and reduce design variance.
Exclude the incomplete testimonial entry and keep testimonial cards to three valid items only.
Use mobile stacking for all grids and cards; no carousel, tabs, accordion, sticky CTA, or reveal interactions are required.
Maintain clear section separation using the spacing scale 24/32/48/64/96 and generous vertical rhythm between major modules.
